note: getProcessor returns an anonymous CompilerPass (PeepholeRemoveDeadCodeTest$1) whose process(externs, root) only does `new PeepholeOptimizationsPass(compiler, getName(), new PeepholeRemoveDeadCode()).process(externs, root)`. CompilerTestCase calls getProcessor(compiler).process(...) immediately (CompilerTestCase.java lines 1266 and 1689), both constructors only store their arguments (PeepholeOptimizationsPass.java lines 40-54; PeepholeRemoveDeadCode has the implicit no-arg constructor), and getName() returns the same value at either time. Building the delegate directly is therefore equivalent, and it keeps PeepholeRemoveDeadCode reachable by --mutate-noop (a verbatim helper would construct it outside the DSL).
